# @loom/testing

Testing kit for Loom apps — spin up an in-memory app, wait on surfaces, capture golden logs, and record/replay LLM calls, all over defineConfig

## Entry points

- `@loom/testing`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
